evidence_candidates.excerpt: Measurements on an HBM-enabled Sapphire Rapids system show substantial gains for some scientific workloads but no benefit for another tested application. BIOS power settings also changed both energy and performance, demonstrating configuration and workload dependence.
evidence_candidates.statement_supported: Peer-reviewed scientific-workload measurements on an earlier HBM system show that HBM benefit is application- and configuration-dependent, so HBM4 peak and vendor efficiency figures cannot be treated as universal application outcomes.
